name: voltade-monorepo
description: Voltade — HTML5 games portal CMS. TypeScript monorepo: Next.js 15 (web) + NestJS 12 (api) + PostgreSQL 16 / Prisma (db) + Redis / BullMQ + S3-R2 + Socket.IO. The repo also still hosts the legacy PHP Nawras engine (src/, db/, tools/) whose gates remain in test:legacy.

scripts.test: npm run -s bridge && python3 tools/verify_php.py && python3 tools/prove_runtime.py && python3 tools/gen_schema_sql.py --verify && python3 tools/gen_license_rules.py --verify && python3 -c "import json;[json.load(open(f)) for f in ['db/schema.json','db/migrations.json','db/license_rules.json','db/oss_pack.json','composer.json']];print('✓ json valid')"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @voltade/shared && npm run build -w @voltade/db
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @voltade/api && npm run build -w @voltade/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @voltade/api && npm run typecheck -w @voltade/web
scripts.test:voltade: npm run build:packages && npm run test:db && npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:voltade
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
